tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgo rum bla ma lha khang gsar pa'i dkar chag yid kyi 'dod 'jo bzhugs so// bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig gangs can bod kyi lte ba rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bla brang thams cad kyi/ /thog mar gyur pa gtsug gi nor bu mchog 1 /sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po 'di nyid kyi/ /sa paṇa gzim chung ka bzhi ma nyid la/ /zhabs thog 'bul ba nyid dang dus mtshungs par/ /de yi steng du sngon med gtsug lag khang / 2 /mthong ba don yod ces bya 'di nyid du/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen dang / /'dzam gling chos srid bdag po 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /srid gsum bla ma theg chen chos rje ste/ 3 /'gran zla bral ba'i skyes chen rnam gsum gyi/ /so so'i 'dra sku rang rang phyag nas ma/ /sku dngos nyid dang byin rlabs dbyer med pa'i/ /gsol ba btab na dgos 'dod ma lus pa/ 4 /stsol bar nges pa'i sku brnyan rnam gsum la/ /bzhugs gnas lha khang bzhugs khyim yid 'ongs dang / /gnam rgyan sa rgyan logs kun bris thang gis/ /mdzes par khyab pa'i bla ma lha khang 'di/ 5 /bzhugs khyim seṅges btegs pa'i rin chen khrir/ /ngo mtshar me tog padma'i sdong bu la/ /srog chags gzugs brnyan rin chen dbang rgyal gyis/ /mdzes par byas sogs mig gi bdud rtsi 'di/ 6 /sor mo'i 'phrul las skrun par byed po ni/ /ser thogs rgyal po shes rab 'byung gnas dang / /grags pa rin chen la sogs ban skya lngas/ /dad dang brtson pas ring po min par bsgrubs/ 7 /da ltar gdan sa chen po mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /rmad byung bla ma lha khang gsar pa 'di/ /'khon gyi rigs skyes dge bsnyen paṇḍi mkhas pa/ ta/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ 8 /mi phyed dad pas legs par bsgrubs pa 'dis/ /mtshon pa'i dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam pa mthar phyin bstan pa rgyas pa dang /

9 /skye ba phyi ma bdag la yid gtad pa'i/ /bu slob rnams kyis gtso byas 'gro ba kun/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /'khrul snang bar do'i 'jigs skrag mi mthong bar/ 10 /rnam shes 'phos 'phral mkha' spyod 'og min dang / /bde ldan zhing ngam shar phyogs mngon dga' sogs/ /dag pa'i zhing du thogs med legs bsgrod de/ /rang nyid spangs rtogs yon tan myur rdzogs nas/ 11 /gang 'dul sprul pas spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan 'di yid 'ongs lha lam nam mkha'i ming / yangs pa la/ /'od zer brgya pa nyi ma'i ming / sa mdzes par byas pa bzhin/ /dbyig 'dzin sa gzhi'i ming / khyon 'di ma lus 'od snang gis/ 12 /gnam bkos bskal pa'i ming / bar du rab tu gsal byas te/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /dbyar mtsho bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas byed pa'i/ /mthu dang nus pa'i gter du 'gyur bar shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ sgo rum bla ma lha khang gsar pa'i dkar chag yid bzhin 'dod 'jo/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
